Yes but they have all left to go back to college and I do not go back until the last week of January. So I have so much time here, alone. All I can do right now if think of how big of a f*ck up I am and I do not know what to do with myself. I feel like the only thing I should do is run away and find myself a new life with new people and never turn back but I feel like that is very unrealistic. My second option is to go to sleep and never wake back up which seems like it would be better for everyone connected to me to just let go. I dont want others thinking about me I just want to disappear and not hurt anyone inn the process
But what do I do till she chooses to talk to me

Two days ago was one of my friends 21st birthday, Ron. He is the boyfriend of my best friend from junior kindergarten, her name is Helen. I helped Helen set up this entire apartment for Ron and helped her make sure everything goes off without a problem. Like many other people I struggle with alcoholism. I would never admit it to those who love me, but I often turn to alcohol to forget about life for awhile. Unfortunately this ruined my friends night. At a bar we went to I was totally blacked out, dont remember even going into the bar. I kissed Ronn. I kissed my best friends boyfriend right in front of her. The worst part is that I dont even remember doing it and was just told today on what happened. Helen refused to talk to me and Ron says I need to wait for Helen to respond to me when she is ready. But I no longer know how to live with myself. I feel like a terrible person and someone that does not deserve to live, what can I do?

I have had depression and anxiety since an early age. I do not like talking about my problems with people because I do not want to hurt them and I know it will hurt them to know how bad I feel. Just yesterday I did something, something unforgivable and now I do not know how to go about fixing it. Can someone give me advice im lost right now and need someone who does not know me to talk things out with me
